limitations: Exact board agreement is evaluated against supplied public annotations, not live service acceptance.
Image classification and board evaluation use different datasets and units.
Models were not trained, prompts were not tuned, and reference annotations were not changed.
Pretrained model overlap with the evaluation images is unknown.
Two annotation-conflict boards remain in the main 1000-board result; a separate 998-board sensitivity result is included.
Model outputs were verified offline across separate jobs. The source Notebook and MoE process retain their error/timeout states.
